faq.q: is the venture approved, dtcp rera approval
faq.a: Both ventures are DTCP approved with clear titles. We share the layout approval copy and the document set at the site visit.

faq.q: how do i book a plot, what is the booking amount
faq.a: Pay a token amount of 1 lakh to block a plot for 7 days, then 30% within 15 days. The balance is by registration.

faq.q: can i visit the site, site visit
faq.a: Yes, we run free site visits every day from 10 AM to 5 PM with pickup from Hyderabad. Tell me the day you prefer.

faq.q: do you give loans or bank finance
faq.a: Plots in both ventures are eligible for loans from major banks. Our team will connect you with a loan partner.

faq.q: what is the registration process and charges
faq.a: Registration happens at the sub-registrar office. Stamp duty and registration are paid by the buyer as per government rates.
